Specification: This module is a parser and precedence test for a wide variety of user-definable infix operators in TLA+. It declares a single variable x with a trivial stuttering next-state action, then defines many custom infix operators that all return a tuple <<a, b>>, and uses the operator Inv to check associativity and precedence relationships by evaluating expressions and invoking TLC's Print and Assert operators. The specification is not modeling a distributed algorithm or fault-tolerant protocol; instead, it is validating syntactic binding behavior of operators, sequence concatenation, and precedence interactions among custom operators and built-in symbols.
